description_en: Creates a compute resource in a specified workspace. The compute resource can be in the development environment or production environment
description_zh: 在指定项目空间创建一条计算资源，可以是开发环境或生产环境

name: CreateComputeResource

parameters.help_en: The name of the compute resource. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit or underscore. The name can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源的名称，由字母、数字、下划线组合，且不能以数字和下划线开头，最长255 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the compute resource. Multiple compute resource types are supported
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源的类型，目前已经支持多种计算资源类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The category for adding the compute resource. Different types have different subtypes with different parameter constraints. For example, a Hologres compute resource supports InstanceMode (instance mode) and UrlMode (connection string mode)
parameters.help_zh: 据源添加的类别，不同Type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，以Hologres计算资源举例有：InstanceMode（实例模式）、UrlMode（连接串模式）
parameters.name: connection_properties_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the compute resource. The description can be up to 3,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源描述信息，长度不超过 3000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The connection configuration of the compute resource, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The EnvType field is a member property of this object and specifies the environment of the compute resource. Valid values: DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment). The EnvType value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。计算资源环境EnvType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境），EnvType取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: connection_properties

Id.description_en: The ID of the created compute resource

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
